exp_ey_p1_title: Bank Credit Card Limit & Approval Advisory

proj_p1_summary: Webank Capstone | Full-business-loop multi-agent system for DeFi price-manipulation security audit.
proj_p1_d1: Led design and implementation of a multi-agent DeFi security audit system covering 21 price-manipulation attack patterns — from attack data enhancement and PoC generation to contract vulnerability analysis and bilingual report delivery.
proj_p1_d2: Engineered the agent infrastructure — cognitive loop with convergence early-stopping, tool registry with retry/cache/timeout policies, three-tier memory (working/episodic/semantic), and dual-model routing with graceful degradation.
proj_p1_d3: Built the evaluation layer — 92.9% root-cause recall and 100% case hit rate vs raw-LLM baselines, zero false positives on 10 audited contracts; productized as a JWT-secured REST API with Docker deployment and 79 unit tests.
proj_p2_summary: HKUST Course Project | Evidence-constrained RAG pipeline for safety-critical automotive QA.
proj_p2_d1: Owned the generation module of a Chinese automotive QA system — designed evidence-constrained generation to suppress hallucination in safety-critical instructions; built the full retrieve–rerank–generate pipeline with multi-strategy PDF chunking.
proj_p2_d2: Implemented multi-recall retrieval (FAISS dense + BM25 + TF-IDF) fused with cross-encoder reranking, query rewriting, and answer-before-retrieve strategies — achieved higher contextual precision than a larger LLM baseline.
proj_p2_d3: Deployed the system via vLLM and Docker with context-aware prompting, explicit evidence injection, and recursive answer refinement.
proj_p3_title: Ablation Study on Extended SFT + GRPO
proj_p3_summary: Systematic ablation study | Extended SFT + GRPO on math reasoning LLMs (1.5B–14B).
proj_p3_d1: Ran systematic ablations of extended SFT + GRPO reinforcement learning across 1.5B/7B/14B models, evaluated on MATH500 — demonstrated reproducible findings on the functional separation of SFT maximizing accuracy and GRPO improving token efficiency.
proj_p3_d2: Found that cosine-similarity rewards outperform binary accuracy; combining cosine reward with length penalty yields the best accuracy-efficiency trade-off; LoRA (rank=32) approaches full-parameter GRPO at significantly lower cost.
proj_p3_d3: Designed the experiment pipeline, managed training runs across model scales, and documented findings with full reproducibility notes — achieving +4.8–5.7pp accuracy improvement across all scales.
